pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal shapes with predominantly rounded vertices and soft edge gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the neck and shoulder regions, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and circular geometries on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white topological network with high connectivity. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, appearing widest at the base of the neck and narrowing as the network extends towards the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, high-frequency serrated contour along the cervical midline. The silhouette consists of short, densely packed vertical filaments with low amplitude variation against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic avian organisms (oxpeckers); one dark silhouette is perched on the right lateral mid-neck, and a second is visible on the dorsal ridge near the top frame limit.
